column1: # Generated by scripts/corpus/dupe-points.ts — every grammar-point pair the detector
# raises, with a hand-verified verdict. NOTHING IS MERGED: gex ids are keyed on the
# point title, so retiring a point orphans a learner's FSRS schedule with nothing to
# detect it, and there is no title→title migration. See the header of the script.
